title: How veTokenomics & Gauge Voting Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph L1["Layer 1: Voting Escrow"]
        A[User locks gov token] --> B["ve power = slope * time"]
        B --> C[Power decays to unlock]
    end
    subgraph L2["Layer 2: Gauge Router"]
        D[Vote weights onto gauges] --> E[Split epoch emissions]
        E --> F[Stream tokens to LPs]

        G[Third party deposits bounty] --> H[Pay ve voters per gauge]
    end
    C --> D

title: Attack Vector
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Rent["Rentable Voting Power"]
        A[Flash-loan gov tokens] --> B[Mint or lock ve power]
        B --> C[Delegate to slave contract]
        C --> D[Cast deciding vote]
        D --> E[Undelegate and withdraw]
    end
    subgraph Route["Routing Errors"]
        F[Vote for gaugeless pool] --> G[Emissions silently lost]
        H[Deactivated gauge kept] --> I[Phantom emissions drawn]
    end
    subgraph Acct["Accounting Failure"]
        J["claimable not zeroed"] --> K[Double-counted emissions]
        K --> L[Voter contract insolvent]
        M[Unbounded gauge loop] --> N[Distribution exceeds gas]
    end
    E --> O[Protocol control captured]
